rationale: The original short thesis relied on price holding below the 5-minute 9-EMA amidst a market selloff, but INTU has reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($276.38) and is now trading at $276.75 while the broader market recovers (SPY improving from -3.06% to -2.77% and VIXY pulling back from +8.62% to +7.04%).
